# Goal
Advise the sole lore L1 on one r86 calibration move: expose ambiguous provenance-holder references and the permanently unassessed continuity/tick-order tail without choosing identities or changing comparisons. Baseline 5eb9451baff217c19d5786405f9b2aa500b7c1b7; inherited candidate corpus/fixtures/check_bible.py. Read .ufo/rounds/r86/wwkd-plan.md and the named slice before reasoning.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/lore-shokunin. Each member owns only its renderer-named report; all code, corpus, fixtures, LOG, SCORECARD and other reports are read-only. Parent owns shared-file integration. LEAF: no delegation, child processes for orchestration, background jobs, tests, builds, lint or formatters. Static evidence only while wave is in flight; specify exact parent-run acceptance scenarios. No push, commits, routing/config changes, native transcript reads, secrets, external research or substrate remediation. Report exact file/line evidence, consumer-visible risk, no-change recommendation when justified, and limits. These are advisory reports, never native judgment, promotion or outside discernment review. Required existing route bindings: content/scribe @m_composer; scout/review/critic @m_grok; connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. If actual route cannot meet that requirement, report the missing binding; do not substitute. The L1 must gate route authorization before dispatch.

dispatch.note: Issue exactly one batched task call carrying every spawn lane, plus one hub send per resume lane. Never split a wave into multiple task calls (one-swarm-per-wave).
